human_sources.title: Unified approach to classification of actions of discrete amenable groups on injective factors
human_sources.role: The simultaneous action and coefficient comparison is the classical construction in [Masuda], Section 4, especially Lemmas 4.2–4.7. The matched inner values cancel the mixed defects before quotient cohomology is used. This lesson writes that mechanism with actual inner implementing unitaries in a semifinite factor and a left-coset section. The result at this stage is a genuine ultrapower cocycle; its coordinate representatives satisfy the full law in the limit.
